description: Enrolled: the pins in the sandbox image (sandbox-workspace/package.json, the global typescript in Dockerfile.sandbox and the venv's pip in sandbox-venv/requirements.txt, whose hashes Renovate refreshes with hashin) and the runtime base images of Dockerfile.runner-dind and Dockerfile.api. Lock file maintenance refreshes the transitive deps in sandbox-workspace/package-lock.json weekly; Renovate cannot raise vulnerability-driven PRs for transitive npm deps.

packageRules.description: The n8n assistant writes its own package.json into the workspace and runs npm install, which only finds nothing to do when the image has the same versions. Follow the SDK version of n8n's stable line, which is released almost daily, once a week.

n8n pins these itself in the package.json it writes. Follow the versions in n8n's stable git tag instead of npm: the custom datasources read them from n8n's source, so a lookup failure on the dependency dashboard means n8n moved or renamed a pin. The global typescript in Dockerfile.sandbox follows the same pin, so tsc on PATH and the workspace's copy stay one version. tsx takes npm updates: n8n's release build writes "tsx": "*".
Dockerfile.sandbox is in includePaths only for the typescript pin, read by the custom regex manager. The Dockerfile manager's default file patterns match it too.
Only the runtime base images are enrolled. The golang builder stages are shared with Dockerfiles Renovate does not cover, and follow go.mod.

dockerd, containerd and runc in the runner come from this image. Stay on Docker 29, and treat the Alpine release in the tag as part of the version, so a newer Alpine build is picked up once upstream stops publishing the current one. Release candidates do not match.
